card.name: Words just before a journal name
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation that come right before a journal or publication name in a citation or news item, such as 'Submitted to:', 'Journal or Publication Title:', 'online edition of', or 'issue of'.

modes.label: Colon in repository metadata
modes.description: A colon or label word in a record field that leads into the journal or publisher name.
modes.example: Submitted to<<:>> Mississippi Agricultural and Forestry Experiment Station Research

modes.label: Edition or issue wording in news
modes.description: Words like edition, online, or issue of that lead into a journal name in a research news story.
modes.example: The breakthrough is detailed in the Nov. 5 online<< edition>> of Nano Letters.

card.plain: It fires on the small words that come just before the name of a journal where a study was published.
